name: CDD Periodic Review (Corporate)
orchestration_notes: CAP-005 (Compliance & Regulatory) owns the CDD review lifecycle. CAP-002 (Commercial Banking) is notified of review outcomes via events. No capability calls another capability's API directly.

phases.name: Review Trigger and Scheduling
phases.description: A CDD periodic review is triggered for a corporate client. Triggers: (1) scheduled cycle — review date reached based on risk rating (annually for PEP/high-risk, every 3 years for standard); (2) event-driven trigger — change in beneficial ownership, adverse media alert, sanctions list update, or transaction monitoring anomaly. SVC-015 creates a CddReviewCase.
persona_actions: PER-052 confirms review priority and assigns to KYC analyst
system_actions: Scheduled job or event trigger creates CddReviewCase: client_id, review_type, trigger_reason, risk_tier, due_date
SVC-015 publishes CddReviewTriggered (EVT-142)
SVC-014 consumes CddReviewTriggered to pre-load existing KYC record for analyst
phases.exit_condition: CddReviewCase created with status = triggered; assigned to analyst

phases.name: KYC Document Collection and Verification
phases.description: KYC analyst collects updated CDD documents from the corporate client: certificate of incorporation, latest accounts, ownership structure chart, UBO declarations (PSC register for UK companies), source of funds documentation. Documents verified against Companies House and other authoritative sources.
persona_actions: KYC analyst sends document request to corporate client via secure portal
KYC analyst verifies documents: authenticity, currency, consistency with prior record
KYC analyst records verified beneficial ownership structure (UBO data)
system_actions: SVC-015 generates document request checklist based on risk_tier and entity_type
SVC-015 records received documents in CddReviewCase.documents_received
SVC-014 runs identity verification on new/changed UBOs
SVC-015 updates CddReviewCase status = documents_under_review
If UBO changed: SVC-015 publishes BeneficialOwnershipChanged (EVT-143)
phases.exit_condition: All documents received and verified; UBO data current; CddReviewCase status = documents_verified

phases.name: Risk Scoring and Screening
phases.description: SVC-014 runs updated risk assessment: sanctions screening of all UBOs and corporate entity, PEP screening, adverse media check, and country risk scoring. Updated client risk rating calculated. High-risk findings trigger Enhanced Due Diligence.
persona_actions: KYC analyst reviews screening results and risk score
If EDD required: analyst collects additional documentation
KYC analyst records risk assessment rationale
system_actions: SVC-014 runs real-time sanctions screening on all UBOs and corporate entity
SVC-014 runs PEP screening and adverse media check
SVC-014 calculates updated risk_rating: low / medium / high / PEP
SVC-015 updates KycAssessment.risk_rating and next_review_date
If sanctions_hit: SVC-015 publishes CddSanctionsHitDetected (EVT-144)
If risk_rating changed: SVC-015 publishes CddRiskRatingChanged (EVT-145)
SVC-015 updates CddReviewCase status = risk_assessed
phases.exit_condition: Risk assessment complete; risk_rating updated; screening results recorded

phases.name: Review Decision and Approval
phases.description: Compliance Officer reviews the completed assessment and makes the periodic review decision: continue relationship, continue with enhanced monitoring, or escalate to exit. Senior Manager approval required for relationship exit.
persona_actions: PER-052 reviews full assessment and records review decision
If escalate_to_exit: PER-059 (Senior Manager) approval required
PER-052 updates next_review_date based on new risk_rating
system_actions: PER-052 records decision: continue | continue_with_edd | escalate_to_exit | suspend_account
SVC-015 updates KycAssessment: last_reviewed_at, next_review_date, risk_rating, review_decision
SVC-015 publishes CddReviewCompleted (EVT-146)
If escalate_to_exit: SVC-015 publishes CddExitEscalated (EVT-147)

phases.name: Outcome Communication and Record Update
phases.description: Review outcome communicated to Relationship Manager. KYC records updated and archived. CAP-002 (Commercial Banking) notified via event. Next review scheduled.
persona_actions: PER-050 receives outcome notification for their portfolio client
If exit: PER-050 initiates client offboarding
If enhanced monitoring: PER-050 updates client engagement plan
system_actions: SVC-005 (Commercial Banking Core, CAP-002) consumes CddReviewCompleted — updates internal client risk flag
SVC-015 archives CddReviewCase with all documents and decision trail
SVC-103 records full review lifecycle immutably (7-year retention)
SVC-015 schedules next_review_date in review queue
phases.exit_condition: Outcome communicated; KYC records updated; next review scheduled; audit record created

happy_path.description: CDD periodic review triggered for standard-risk corporate client. Documents collected within 14 days. Screening clear. Risk rating remains medium. Relationship continued. CddReviewCompleted published. Next review scheduled in 3 years.

alternative_paths.name: Event-Triggered Out-of-Cycle Review
alternative_paths.description: A change in beneficial ownership or adverse media alert triggers an out-of-cycle CDD review. Same workflow as periodic but trigger_reason = event_triggered. Review priority elevated.

alternative_paths.name: High-Risk / PEP — Enhanced Due Diligence
alternative_paths.description: Risk screening returns PEP match or high-risk country. EDD required: senior management approval, source of wealth documentation, enhanced monitoring. Review frequency increased to annually.

exception_paths.name: Sanctions Hit Detected
exception_paths.description: Screening returns a sanctions match on a UBO or corporate entity. Account suspended immediately. OFSI notification required within 14 days if confirmed. Relationship exit initiated.
exception_paths.internal_action: CddSanctionsHitDetected (EVT-144) published; PER-052 notified; account suspended; OFSI notification workflow initiated

exception_paths.name: Client Fails to Provide Documents
exception_paths.description: Corporate client fails to respond within 14-day SLA. Account restrictions applied. If no response within 30 days: relationship exit initiated.
exception_paths.internal_action: PER-050 notified; account restrictions applied if high-risk; escalation to exit after 30 days

exception_paths.name: Relationship Exit
exception_paths.description: Decision to exit client relationship. PER-059 authorises. PER-050 notifies client. Account deactivated in orderly manner.
exception_paths.trigger: review_decision = escalate_to_exit and PER-059 approval confirmed
exception_paths.internal_action: CddExitEscalated (EVT-147) published; CAP-002 notified to initiate offboarding

design_decisions.decision: CDD review lifecycle owned by CAP-005 (Compliance). CAP-002 (Commercial Banking) receives outcomes via events.
design_decisions.rationale: CDD is a compliance obligation — legal accountability sits with the MLRO. Coupling Commercial Banking to CDD decisions would create regulatory risk where commercial incentives influence CDD independence.
alternatives_considered: Commercial Banking initiates and Compliance reviews
design_decisions.rejected_because: Joint ownership dilutes regulatory accountability. Commercial Banking initiation risks downgraded risk assessments.
